title: Bind Skill verification to the requested identity
goal: Ensure M6 reports verified=true only when both the SkillExecutionReceipt identity matches the requested Skill and the executor verifies its output.
context: M6 already treats a receipt as successful only when receipt.skillID matches the requested skillID, but its audit payload currently copies receipt.verified directly. A mismatched receipt with verified=true can therefore produce succeeded=false alongside verified=true.
forbidden_changes: Do not accept output from a mismatched Skill identity.
Do not change Skill selection, policy, or capability semantics.
Do not convert a mismatched receipt into a successful observation.
acceptance_criteria: A receipt with the wrong skillID and verified=true results in succeeded=false and verified=false in both actionExecuted and observationProduced.
The goal aborts and actionID linkage remains intact.
A matching receipt with verified=true continues to pass the existing success regression.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Derive the externally recorded verified flag from both receipt identity and receipt verification; preserve fail-closed behavior.
